review_comment:
初めてストレッチを経験しましたが、とてもスッキリしました。可動域が広がってるかもという実感があり、体のバランスが整った感じがありました。また利用させていただきます。

(Translated by Google)
This was my first time experiencing stretching, and I feel incredibly refreshed. I feel like my range of motion has increased, and my body feels more balanced. I will definitely use your services again.

review_comment:
自分にあった施術をしてもらい
体もスッキリ！
悩みだった体のかたさも
改善できそうです。

(Translated by Google)
I received treatment tailored to my needs, and my body feels refreshed!

It seems like the stiffness in my body, which had been a problem for me, will also improve.

肩が酷く、通うことにしました。
肩甲骨がとても酷く、痛いくらいが好みの自分にはちょうど良い痛みで体はすっきりしました。
都度力加減も聞いてくれるので痛い時は痛いと言えるのはありがたいです。

(Translated by Google)
My shoulder was in terrible condition, so I decided to go for treatment.

My shoulder blades were really bad, and the pain was just right for me, as I actually prefer it to be quite intense. My body felt refreshed afterward.

They ask about the pressure level each time, so I appreciate being able to tell them if it hurts.
